summary: Video-game adaptations of the Shadowrun tabletop setting, spanning distinct console RPGs, the 2007 multiplayer shooter, Harebrained Schemes' tactical RPG trilogy, and the discontinued Shadowrun Chronicles online game.

entries.title: Shadowrun

emulation.notes: Use accurate SNES emulation for the cleanest stream capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original 16-bit assets with emulator-side scaling and latency controls.

primary.version: Original Super NES release via accurate emulation
primary.why: The 1993 Shadowrun is a Super NES-only action RPG, so accurate SNES emulation is the highest-fidelity and complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Super NES cartridge/image through an accurate emulator such as bsnes or Mesen with integer scaling and low-latency capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster or later port is documented.

entries.title: Shadowrun

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original 16-bit assets with emulator-side scaling and clean capture.

primary.version: Original Sega Genesis release via accurate emulation
primary.why: The 1994 Shadowrun is a separate Sega Genesis game and was released only on Genesis/Mega Drive, making accurate emulation the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Sega Genesis cartridge/image through a high-accuracy Genesis emulator such as BlastEm or Genesis Plus GX.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster or later port is documented.

entries.title: Shadowrun

emulation.emulator: Genesis Plus GX or another accurate Sega CD/Mega-CD emulator
emulation.notes: Japanese-only release; use an original disc/image and matching BIOS.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Mega-CD presentation with emulator-side scaling.

primary.version: Original Japanese Mega-CD release via accurate emulation
primary.why: The 1996 Shadowrun is a Japan-only Mega-CD visual-novel RPG and has no documented alternate official platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Japanese Mega-CD disc/image through accurate Sega CD/Mega-CD emulation with the required system BIOS.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official English release, remaster, or later port is documented.

entries.title: Shadowrun

emulation.notes: Use PC compatibility fixes as needed; Xbox 360 emulation is not the preferred route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output, subject to game and service limitations.

primary.version: Windows Vista / Games for Windows release
primary.why: The Windows release is the highest-fidelity capture route for the 2007 multiplayer shooter and supports PC display/output control; the Xbox 360 release has no exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows release with current compatibility notes; verify Games for Windows Live/community-service requirements before a stream.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster is documented; online/service dependencies may affect practical play.

entries.title: Shadowrun Returns

emulation.notes: Use the current PC release rather than emulating console versions.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with the current trilogy/remastered build.

primary.why: Windows offers the best fidelity and capture route, while the 2022 Shadowrun Trilogy version keeps the game available alongside the remastered trilogy package.
primary.how_to_play: Play Shadowrun Returns on Windows, preferably through Shadowrun Trilogy or the current PC storefront build, applying display and compatibility fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console Trilogy versions add modern console availability but no documented exclusive campaign content.

entries.title: Shadowrun: Dragonfall
entries.definitive_edition: Shadowrun: Dragonfall - Director's Cut on Windows

emulation.notes: Use the native PC Director's Cut.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with the expanded edition.

primary.version: Shadowrun: Dragonfall - Director's Cut on Windows
primary.why: Director's Cut is the expanded standalone version of Dragonfall, and Windows provides the best capture/fidelity route with no console-exclusive content documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play Shadowrun: Dragonfall - Director's Cut on Windows, either standalone or as part of Shadowrun Trilogy, with current PC compatibility notes.

entries.remaster_caveats: The original Dragonfall was DLC for Shadowrun Returns; Director's Cut is the standalone expanded version.

entries.title: Shadowrun: Hong Kong
entries.definitive_edition: Shadowrun: Hong Kong - Extended Edition on Windows

emulation.notes: Use the native PC Extended Edition.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with Extended Edition content.

primary.version: Shadowrun: Hong Kong - Extended Edition on Windows
primary.why: Extended Edition adds a new campaign, developer commentary, and bug fixes, and Windows is the best fidelity/capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Shadowrun: Hong Kong - Extended Edition on Windows, either standalone or as part of Shadowrun Trilogy, with current PC compatibility notes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Extended Edition was a free update for owners of the original game; console Trilogy versions add modern console availability but no documented exclusive campaign content.

entries.title: Shadowrun Chronicles: Boston Lockdown
entries.definitive_edition: None currently playable through a normal official route

emulation.notes: Do not plan a normal playthrough unless an authorized server restoration is confirmed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Historical PC client; server dependency is the limiting factor.

primary.why: Windows was one of the original PC platforms and would be the best capture route, but the game relied on online servers that were shut down in 2018.
primary.how_to_play: There is no normal current play route; treat this as a documented unavailable online game unless an authorized server restoration appears.

entries.remaster_caveats: Server shutdown makes the game unavailable through normal play despite documented PC platform releases.
